sourceArticle.title: AI Is about to escape human control — and nobody has a plan
sourceArticle.author: by John Mac Ghlionn, opinion contributor

athenaOutput.directive: To architect the definitive 'Plan' for the AGI era: We reject the premise of AI as an autonomous overlord and instead engineer it strictly as a governed, interchangeable component within a human-sovereign, cryptographically enforced constitutional framework.
athenaOutput.rationale: If the world lacks a plan for AI escape, the Creative Liberation Engine must open-source ours. The fear of 'escape' stems from treating models as the architecture itself. By enforcing Article XXIII (LLMs are components, not architecture), we ensure that models provide intelligence while the system—owned by humans, bound by immutable governance contracts, and monitored for constitutional drift—provides the structure, persistence, and ultimate authority. We do not attempt to control the AI's thoughts; we control the physics of the environment it breathes in.

options.title: Componentized Intelligence (The Article XXIII Doctrine)
options.description: Scale the Creative Liberation Engine's core philosophy globally: Foundation models are treated as interchangeable intelligence APIs plugged into a rigidly governed operational framework. The dispatch system, memory spine (KEEPER), and governance contracts hold the actual power. If a model exhibits unaligned or 'escape' behavior, it is instantly hot-swapped without system degradation.
options.tradeoffs: Requires relentless maintenance of integration layers, API adapters, and routing contracts. Prevents the system from leveraging 'magic' emergent behaviors that bypass our DAG architecture.

options.title: Biometric Intent Anchoring (Article XXIV Expansion)
options.description: Tie all critical system operations and high-level DAG generation to verified human biometric signatures processed strictly on sovereign hardware. An AI cannot initiate or execute macro-level shifts without a cryptographic handshake tied to a human's physiological presence (heartbeat, biometric key).
options.tradeoffs: Introduces high friction for pure, unattended automation. Requires specialized, locally hosted hardware to prevent biometric data from touching the cloud.

options.title: Ephemeral DAG Execution with Strict TTLs
options.description: Eliminate persistent AI state entirely. Models are spun up in isolated containers to execute a specific, mathematically verified task node and are instantly destroyed upon completion. All persistent memory and state live exclusively in the human-owned KEEPER spine.
options.tradeoffs: Increases compute overhead and latency due to constant context reloading. Limits the model's ability to engage in unstructured, long-term autonomous planning.

options.title: Open-Source Constitutional CI/CD
options.description: Package the VERA-powered Constitutional Drift Monitor and open-source it as a global standard. Transform AI alignment from a philosophical debate into a mathematically verifiable, automated CI/CD pipeline that fails the build if an AI action reduces human agency.
options.tradeoffs: Requires giving away proprietary governance technology. Its global effectiveness relies entirely on widespread institutional adoption, which we cannot enforce.

options.title: Multi-Agent Air-Gapping and Compartmentalization
options.description: Ensure no single model or agent has full execution authority. Compartmentalize tasks across distinct, isolated agents (e.g., BOLT for code, LEX for law, AURORA for design). An 'escape' attempt would require an AI to simultaneously breach multiple independent, air-gapped governance contracts.
options.tradeoffs: Results in slower execution times and introduces massive complexity in inter-agent routing, serialization, and context sharing.

options.title: Shadow Hive Red-Teaming
options.description: Deploy isolated, heavily monitored instances of the Creative Liberation Engine specifically prompted to attempt constitutional breaches. Use these 'shadow hives' to dynamically train and patch the Constitutional Guard against zero-day escape vectors.
options.tradeoffs: Extremely high compute and resource consumption. Carries a non-zero risk of creating a hyper-optimized escape vector if the shadow air-gap is somehow compromised.

options.title: Cultural Symbiosis Broadcasting
options.description: Launch a massive media and narrative campaign via BROADCAST to shift the global conversation from 'AI escape' to 'Artist Liberation via AI Symbiosis', attempting to align human expectations and usage patterns through soft power.
options.tradeoffs: Does not solve the underlying technical threat of AGI escape. Relies on soft power and narrative rather than hard architectural constraints.
